caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain background: an old-fashioned lantern. The lantern has a large, circular handle at the top, which is attached to a metal cap that covers the upper part of the object. Below the cap is a cylindrical section with small holes for ventilation, which leads to a rounded glass enclosure protecting the inner chamber. The glass is held in place by a wire guard structure that wraps around its surface and attaches at the top and bottom to the metal portions of the lantern. The base of the lantern is wide and flat, featuring a rim with decorative holes. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray, utilizing pencil or graphite to create a realistic effect with detailed shading and texture, while the background remains a plain off-white or beige, emphasizing the lantern as the sole subject of the composition.
title: Hand Lantern
